plugins.name: fly
plugins.description: Ship the current work as a pull request with every local check green — reads the repo's CHECKS.md, runs the checks, fixes what breaks, commits, pushes, and opens or updates the PR. Does not wait on CI.

plugins.name: plan-it
plugins.description: Plan a feature by reading the codebase first, deciding everything the repo can already answer, and asking only what is expensive to reverse — data models, public surfaces, vocabulary, scope, UI shape, business rules. Batched multiple-choice questions, then a written plan. Does not enter plan mode and does not implement.
